comparison.objective: Insert a spindle through an electrode-roll core, carry the roll, and deposit both spindle ends on rests.
comparison.physical_skill: Through-bore insertion, two-end load support, and coordinated rigid-load transport.
comparison.success_condition: Exclude direct roll handling, seat both spindle ends on their rests, release, and maintain a stable one-second hold. No full numeric spec is available.
comparison.reason: Tests using an inserted spindle as a load-bearing carrier; the candidate uses a mandrel to transmit an impact and must fracture and recover four tangs.
